parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。多个集群ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The cluster description. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en: The cluster status. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:
MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值范围如下：
MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The query mode for the list. Set the value to Simple to use the simple mode, which returns only basic metadata of clusters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the detailed mode is used by default, which returns detailed information about clusters
parameters.help_zh:
列表查询方式。取值为Simple，表示简略模式，仅返回集群的基本元数据信息。
如果未填写该参数，则默认为详细模式，返回集群的详细信息
parameters.name: describe_type

parameters.help_en: Filters clusters created within the last N days. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 筛选最近N天创建的集群。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: recent_creation_interval

parameters.help_en: Filters clusters that expire within the next N days. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 筛选N天后过期的集群。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: recent_expiration_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否集群已过期。取值范围如下：

true

false
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.
                              
Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为30、50或100。
                              
默认值为30。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can use tags to filter the cluster list. You can specify up to 20 tag pairs. The number n for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The Tag.n.Key parameter is paired with the Tag.n.Value parameter.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key对应的值为Tag.n.Value。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value that corresponds to the tag key.

The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键对应的标签值。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can specify multiple node IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点ID。支持传入多个节点ID，多个ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_node_ids

AiType.description_en:
The AI node information status. Valid values:
     
SearchNode: search node.
DLNode: AI node
AiType.description_zh:
ai 节点信息状态。取值范围如下：
     
SearchNode：搜索节点
DLNode：ai节点

Category.description_en:
The cluster edition. Valid values:

Normal: Cluster Edition.

Basic: Single Node Edition.

Archive: X-Engine Edition.

NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster (Database/Table)
Category.description_zh:
集群系列，目前支持如下系列：

Normal：集群版

Basic：单节点

Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）

NormalMultimaster：多主集群（库表）

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster

DBNodeRole.description_en:
The node role. Valid values: 

Writer: primary node. 
Reader: read-only node. 
ColumnReader: column store read-only node. 
AI: AI node
DBNodeRole.description_zh:
节点角色，取值范围如下： 

Writer：主节点。 
Reader：只读节点。 
ColumnReader：列存只读节点。 
AI：AI节点

HotReplicaMode.description_en:
Indicates whether hot standby is enabled. Valid values:

ON: enabled.
OFF: disabled
HotReplicaMode.description_zh:
是否开启热备。取值范围如下：

ON：开启
OFF：关闭

ImciSwitch.description_en:
Indicates whether In-Memory Column Index (IMCI) is enabled. Valid values:

ON: enabled.
OFF: disabled
ImciSwitch.description_zh:
是否开启列存索引。取值范围如下：

ON：开启
OFF：关闭

Serverless.description_en:
Indicates whether the serverless feature is enabled for the node.

A return value of ON indicates that the serverless feature is enabled.
An empty value indicates that the serverless feature is not enabled
Serverless.description_zh:
当前节点是否开启了Serverless功能。

返回ON表示开启了Serverless功能。
返回空值表示没有开启Serverless功能

DeletionLock.description_en:
The deletion protection status of the cluster. Valid values:
0: not locked.
1: locked.
When the cluster is locked, it cannot be deleted
DeletionLock.description_zh:
集群删除的保护状态，取值范围如下：
0：未锁定。
1：锁定。
锁定状态时，不可以删除集群

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.
This parameter is returned only for Prepaid (subscription) clusters. An empty value is returned for Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false

This parameter is returned only for Prepaid (subscription) clusters
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。取值范围：

true

false

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返该参数

HotStandbyCluster.description_en:
The hot standby storage cluster status. Valid values:

ON: enabled.
OFF: disabled
HotStandbyCluster.description_zh:
存储热备集群。取值范围如下：

ON：开启
OFF：关闭

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the cluster. Valid values: 

Unlock: Normal. 
ManualLock: Manually locked. 
LockByExpiration: Automatically locked due to cluster expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定状态，取值范围如下： 

Unlock：正常。 
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

MemorySize.description_en: The memory size of the node. Unit: MB

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围： 

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月（预付费）。

RemoteMemorySize.description_en: The remote memory size. Unit: MB

SearchStorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the Search node

ServerlessType.description_en: The serverless type. A return value of AgileServerless indicates that the cluster is a serverless cluster. An empty value indicates that the cluster is a common cluster
ServerlessType.description_zh: Serverless类型。返回AgileServerless表示当前集群是Serverless集群，返回空值表示当前集群是普通集群

StoragePayType.description_en:
The storage billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-by-capacity (pay-as-you-go billing method).
Prepaid: pay-by-space (subscription)
StoragePayType.description_zh:
存储计费类型。取值范围： 

Postpaid：按容量计费（按量计费）。
Prepaid：按空间计费（包年包月）。

StorageSpace.description_en: The storage space for pay-by-space (subscription) billing. Unit: bytes
StorageSpace.description_zh: 按空间计费（包年包月）的存储空间。单位：Byte

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type for Enterprise Edition. Valid values:
HighPerformance: PSL5.
Standard: PSL4.

The storage type for Standard Edition. Valid values:
essdpl0
essdpl1
essdpl2
essdpl3
essdautopl
StorageType.description_zh:
企业版存储类型取值如下：
HighPerformance：对应PSL5
Standard：对应PSL4

标准版存储类型取值如下：
essdpl0
essdpl1
essdpl2
essdpl3
essdautopl

StorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the cluster. Unit: bytes
StorageUsed.description_zh: 集群已经使用的存储用量，单位为Byte

StrictConsistency.description_en:
Indicates whether multi-zone data strong consistency is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

ON: Multi-zone data strong consistency is enabled. This applies to Standard Edition 3AZ scenarios.

OFF: Multi-zone data strong consistency is not enabled
StrictConsistency.description_zh:
集群是否开启了多可用区数据强一致。取值范围：

ON：表示开启了多可用区数据强一致，适用于标准版3AZ场景。

OFF：表示未开启多可用区数据强一致

SubCategory.description_en:
The specification type of the compute node. Valid values:
Exclusive: Dedicated.
General: General-purpose
SubCategory.description_zh:
计算节点的规格类型，取值范围如下：
Exclusive：独享规格
General：通用规格

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of clusters on the current page
